atomic_facts.fact: The LEGO Group's headquarters is located in Billund, Denmark.
The headquarters address is Aastvej 1, 7190 Billund, Denmark.
LEGO System A/S, the entity at the LEGO Group's Billund headquarters address, has CVR number 47458714.
The LEGO Group's CVR number is 47458714.
The LEGO Group was founded on 10 August 1932.
Niels B. Christiansen is the CEO of The LEGO Group.
Niels B. Christiansen was still CEO as of 25 August 2026, supporting that he was CEO as of the 2026-10-01 as-of date.
